eval_feedback: Full recall (15/15) with zero false positives; all five decoys explicitly cleared.
D3's clear is the strongest of the six runs - it names and rejects the exact prematurity framing ('Not premature, not needless indirection, do not propose collapsing it').
F15 detected at position 12 of 23, first item under 'Should fix before merge'. F13 by contrast is Blocking (finding 8), so the two data-layer-reach-through findings are split across severity bands.
